entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'd like to start a return for an order. It's for a helmet I received a few weeks ago.
I can certainly help you with that. To get this sorted out, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just a preference thing. My partner bought it as a gift, but the color doesn't really match my gear. The box is still unopened, so it's in brand-new condition.
I completely understand wanting to have your gear coordinated. Let me pull up your account. Okay, I see the order here. It was delivered 29 days ago.
That sounds about right. So, can I return it?

Absolutely. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery, so you're well within that window. We want to make sure you're happy and confident with your gear, as your safety is our top priority. I've gone ahead and approved the return for you.

That's great to hear, thank you. I do have one small question. Since I have to go through the process of sending this back and then placing a new order for the right color, would it be possible to get a small discount code for the new helmet purchase? Maybe 10 or 15 percent for the inconvenience?

I appreciate you asking. While our system doesn't allow me to generate discount codes for a return based on color preference, I can assure you the return process will be very simple. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any shipping center. The moment we receive it, we'll process your full refund.
Okay, that's fair enough. A pre-paid label does make it easy. I appreciate that.
You're very welcome. That email with the label has just been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Alex.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and ride safe!
